issues.legal_issue: The transfer of a tenant’s ownership of land under the statutory acquisition scheme includes the landowner’s rights in trees standing on that land.
material_facts: A cultivating tenant acquired ownership of the tenancy land under the statutory scheme and received a certificate of ownership after paying the assessed compensation.
Trees stood on the land, and the former landowner’s successors sought permission to fell and remove them.
The forestry authorities permitted the sale of the trees but did not issue the necessary orders for felling and removing the timber.
The judgment records no different intention governing the transfer and no proof that the transferred area was a natural forest.
issues.conclusion: The statutory transfer of the land included the landowner’s rights in the standing trees. The Court upheld the mandamus and dismissed the appeal.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 11(6) of the Himachal Pradesh Abolition of Big Landed Estates and Land Reforms Act, 1953, the tenant becomes owner of the tenancy land and the landowner’s rights, title and interest in it determine. That expression includes standing trees: consistent with section 8 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882, a transfer of land includes trees on it unless a different intention is expressed or implied. The comprehensive effect of the transfer is also supported by section 84(a)(i) and the Act’s scheme, including section 15. Achhru Mal v. Maula Bakhsh, (1924) 5 Lah. 385, and Nasib Singh v. Amin Chand, AIR 1942 Lah. 152, were distinguished; Kaju Mal v. Salig Ram, [1919] Punj. Rec. 237, was referred to in connection with the possibility of a different result if the land were proved to be a natural forest.

rule.if: statutory_tenancy_acquisition and ownership_certificate_granted and standing_trees_on_land and not different_transfer_intention and not natural_forest_proven

predicates.statutory_tenancy_acquisition: A cultivating tenant acquired the tenancy land through a statutory ownership-acquisition process.
predicates.ownership_certificate_granted: The tenant received a certificate recognizing ownership of the tenancy land.
predicates.standing_trees_on_land: Trees were standing on the land when ownership was transferred.
predicates.different_transfer_intention: The transfer expressly or impliedly provided that the standing trees would not pass with the land.
predicates.natural_forest_proven: The transferred area was proved to be a natural forest.
predicates.standing_trees_pass_with_transferred_lan: The landowner’s rights in the standing trees pass to the tenant with the transferred land.

issues.definition: When a tenant acquires ownership of land through the statutory process, receives an ownership certificate, and standing trees are on the land, the trees pass with the land unless a different transfer intention applies or the area is proved to be a natural forest.
